description: The Pages section at the top of Record's left column: the open notebook's pages as an indented tree (a sub-page on its own line under its parent), above the notebooks.

parts.name: Pages header
parts.shows: A group header: an arrow, "Pages", and a + button on the right with the tooltip "New page (+Name in a page makes one under it)". The arrow folds the list away (kept); the notebooks section then takes the spare height.
text: New page (+Name in a page makes one under it)

actions.by: click the arrow or the header
actions.does: Folds or unfolds the pages list.
New page dialog (RecordAlerts), the page made at the top level.

parts.name: page row
parts.shows: One line per page, indented by depth (a page called Work:Plans shows as Plans under Work, with a tree line from its parent's name; hovering a sub-page shows its full name). Home is first, then the rest sorted by name, case-insensitively, each parent before its children. The page in the tab shown is selected. What is listed: pages with something written in them, every page a [[link]] anywhere goes to, Home, the pages open, and their parents. A page with nothing written yet is grey and italic. A page whose title is being typed in shows the typed name at once. Names too long fade out. Pages Meta added are marked green; deleted ones stay listed, struck through, until kept or undone (nothing opens from them); moved and highlighted ones are marked too.

actions.does: Opens the page in a tab (shown if already open).

states.name: empty page left
states.shows: A page with nothing written that nothing links to and that is not open and not Home goes from the list (and from the notebook) when its tab closes.
